findings.description: The new `params` argument is never forwarded to `self.request`, so query parameters passed to `Session.get` are silently discarded.
findings.rationale: Calling `session.get(url, params={"q": "example"})` now binds the dictionary to the explicit `params` parameter instead of leaving it in `kwargs`. Because the request call forwards only `kwargs`, the server receives no query parameters, potentially returning incorrect or unfiltered results. Forward `params=params` to preserve existing keyword behavior and support the new positional argument.
